Definition: adverb from the base of G4225; an enclitic particle of indefiniteness of manner; somehow or anyhow; used only in composition:--haply, by any (some) means, perhaps. See G1513, G3381. Compare G4459.
BiblicalUsage: The little particle pos survives only inside other words, never standing on its own. It hides in words like mayhap and howsoever, but no verse in the New Testament reads it by itself, so there is no passage to cite for it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even the smallest pieces of language have their place, but this one only lives as part of larger words, and honesty means saying so instead of inventing a verse.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
